control_title: Applicant identity is verified before disbursal
evidence_requirement: Rule fire log + review disposition sample

control_title: Synthetic identity indicators are detected and dispositioned
Government ID documents are checked for tampering
evidence_requirement: Rule fire log + document review evidence

control_title: PII mismatches against bureau data are investigated
Device and session anomalies are monitored
Application velocity is monitored across identity attributes
regulatory_reference: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual - Suspicious Activity Monitoring

control_title: Automated / bot application traffic is detected
Account takeover attempts are detected and escalated
Mule / third-party disbursal accounts are screened
Geolocation inconsistencies are evaluated
regulatory_reference: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual - Customer Due Diligence

control_title: Stated income misrepresentation is tested
First-party fraud patterns are monitored post-disbursal
regulatory_reference: Interagency Guidance on Credit Risk Review

control_title: Every fraud alert is dispositioned by a trained reviewer
regulatory_reference: FFIEC BSA/AML Manual - Suspicious Activity Reporting

control_title: Alert dispositions are recorded with a reason code
Review queue ageing is monitored
Reviewer decisions are subject to quality assurance sampling
Confirmed fraud is escalated for SAR consideration
Fraud losses are reported to the risk committee monthly
regulatory_reference: Interagency Guidance on Model Risk Management (SR 11-7)

control_title: Active rule inventory is complete and owned
Rule changes follow documented change control
Rule performance is reviewed at least annually
evidence_requirement: Rule registry review dates + precision metrics

control_title: Retired rules are removed from the production decision path
Source data feeding fraud controls is reconciled
Fraud metrics are reproducible for an examiner
